title: Together AI Project API key (tgp_v1_): one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one body character replaced by +, a standard-Base64 character outside [A-Za-z0-9_-], alphabet: one body character replaced by ., outside [A-Za-z0-9_-], and alphabet: one body character replaced by /, a standard-Base64 character outside [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Twin of "Together AI Project API key (tgp_v1_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of together-ai-api-key-json-config: alphabet: one body character replaced by ., outside [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
